item.title: Mayor Jefferies: Water infrastructure, resilience, and what we’re learning
item.description: Over the past several months, many of us have watched with concern as the City of Calgary has dealt with significant water main breaks linked to aging infrastructure. For Calgarians, this has not just been a technical issue, it has meant water restrictions, uncertainty, business disruption and real stress for families. These kinds of events remind us how much we rely on systems we rarely see.
